description: Send a new email with HTML support and file attachments. Use this to send messages, project updates, or any new email conversation.

account_name.description: Name of the email account to use

bcc.description: Array of BCC recipient email addresses

body.description: Email body content (can be plain text or HTML)

body_type.description: Body format: 'plain' for plain text or 'html' for HTML content

cc.description: Array of CC recipient email addresses

from_email.description: Optional sender address. When sender_emails is configured for the account, the address must be in that allowlist.

name: email_send
